terminology_note: Here 'api' means ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL INGREDIENT, never a software interface.
description: Candidate-identification list for the evidence review. These entries record only high-level identity/approval facts to SCREEN candidates. They are NOT qualified profiles and contain NO tissue-penetration, diffusion, clearance, or release parameters. Every field marked verified:false must be confirmed against a primary source (Drugs@FDA label, EMA EPAR, or peer-reviewed characterization) before use. Selecting a candidate for implementation requires user approval (stop gate).
status_legend: candidate_screening only; none is SELECTED or QUALIFIED
